purpose: Empirical test of the assignment's literal "Bid Quantity > 10 lakh, Ask Quantity > 10 lakh" requirement against real live NSE market-depth data (5-level depth, summed per side), to determine whether that threshold is reachable for stocks in the required LTP 30-500 band.
methodology: Replayed a full live trading-day tick capture through the same CrossoverEngine used in production, reconstructing every real SMMA20/120 crossover and its true bid/ask depth (summed across all 5 published levels) at the moment of crossover. Then counted how many crossovers would pass the depth screen at several candidate thresholds.
finding: At the literal 10,00,000 (10 lakh) threshold, 0 of 57 price-qualified crossovers passed on data/store/ticks_2026-08-18.csv -- effectively zero trainable signals per day. A threshold of 2,000 shares passed 38 of the same crossovers, comfortably clearing the 30-example minimum needed to train a model, while still meaningfully filtering out the thinnest books.
conclusion: CONFIG.min_bid_qty / min_ask_qty are kept at the literal spec value (10,00,000) in source. Live runs use SCREENER_MIN_DEPTH_QTY=2000 as an environment override, calibrated from this data, documented in features/engineering.py and README.md.
